src.label: Australian Department of Agriculture (Micor) — Vietnam, dogs (contact for MARD Veterinary Department)

head: Vaccinate against rabies at least 30 days before departure; ask the Veterinary Department about the permit.
lines: The Australian agriculture department says the pet must be vaccinated against rabies at least 30 days before departure, and the certificate must name the practice, the attending vet, the owner and the animal, with microchip number, vaccine, batch and use-by date.
It points exporters to the Veterinary Department of Vietnam's Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development in Hanoi (spsvietnam@mard.gov.vn) for the import process and any permit.
The page does not publish Vietnam's own rules in full, so the ministry is the place to confirm.
